entries.candidate: DigiCo SYD1 Data Centre Expansion, 392-422 Harris Street, Ultimo (SSD-69637456) — construction-phase refresh
entries.reason: The NSW portal's post-approval Notifications folder holds the contractor's condition A9(a) notice dated 7 September 2026 (attached 2026-09-08, AttachRef SSD-69637456-PA-4), filed on behalf of the applicant HDI SYD1 Property Holdings Limited. It states the construction phase (column jacketing on Levels 1-5, two added storeys, upgrade to 88 MW) is scheduled to physically commence on 7 October 2026. A scheduled commencement is future work, and elapsed time cannot establish it; the 9 September condition A15 dilapidation notice is preparatory. The October 15 ASX announcement remains unread behind the ASX terms page (thirty-first hold).
entries.reopen_condition: A dated record or operator/contractor statement, published after 7 October 2026, that the SYD1 construction phase has physically started (or an operator-hosted copy of the 15 October announcement stating current works).

entries.candidate: AirTrunk SYD2 Sydney North campus, 1 Sirius Road, Lane Cove West (SSD-9741) and Apollo Place Data Centre (SSD-67407231, SYD2 Phase 5, 1 Apollo Place)
entries.reason: Not in the Atlas. AirTrunk's SYD2 page (JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-19, captured 2026-10-22) describes an operating campus of multiple buildings over 120 MW on 4.2 ha and says the Apollo Place data centre adjacent to 1 Sirius Road is Phase 5 of its investment and will form one integrated campus. The page's modification date is not bounded by an archived copy or a second dated source (no archive service was used), and the SSD-9741 post-approval records are from 2021 and November 2025. For Apollo Place, consent SSD-67407231 was granted on 9 October 2025 (outside the window); the Department approved its CEMP Rev E on 4 August 2026 (SSD-67407231-PA-2), which does not record physical works. Adding Apollo Place alone as the campus's first project would show an operating campus as merely permitted. The adjoining Mars Road Data Centre (SSD-108835458) is still not tied to AirTrunk by any captured record.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window AirTrunk statement or government record of SYD2 operations (then admit SYD2 existing operations with a 1 Sirius Road lot locator, and add Apollo Place as a second project in a later update), or a dated record of Apollo Place construction.
